title: Coast Guard Top Videos of 2011: Sailboat Rescue
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Coast Guard Sector San Diego rescues a 77-year-old man and his dog from a disabled sailboat that was adrift 120 southwest of San Diego, March 21, 2011. The man and dog were hoisted from the boat and transported safely to San Diego. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Henry G. Dunphy. Also available in high definition.
keywords: top videos of 2011, Coast Guard, search and rescue, High Definition
